rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for architecture as building design or architectural work, and it can also refer broadly to a building style.

example.english: The architecture of this building is very distinctive.
example.traditional: 呢座大樓嘅建築好有特色。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 daai6 lau4 ge3 gin3 zuk1 hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1

rows.note: Use this for architecture as an academic discipline or field of study.

example.jyutping: keoi5 daai6 hok6 duk6 gin3 zuk1 hok6

rows.note: Use this for the structure or design of a system, product, or software system.

example.english: The architecture of this software is quite clear.
example.traditional: 呢個程式嘅架構幾清晰。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ge3 gaa3 kau3 gei2 cing1 sik1

rows.note: Use this when the focus is specifically on a particular architectural style rather than architecture in general.

example.english: The architecture style of this church is very classical.
example.traditional: 呢間教堂嘅建築風格好古典。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gaau3 tong4 ge3 gin3 zuk1 fung1 gaak3 hou2 gu2 din2
